text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days at the summer training camp were 
truly fulfilling. Today, once again, the 
alarm rings at 4:00 AM—
choice_data_list:
(Alright, let's do this! First, 
stretches!)
(Alright, let's do it! First, stretches!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm finished stretching. I'm ready 
whenever. —How about you?
choice_data_list: All good on this end too.
We're all set over here too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's go! —First, at a nice 
and easy pace to warm up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I jog at a relaxed pace alongside Almond 
Eye. Ever since training camp started, 
we've gathered at sunrise, and I've been 
accompanying her on light jogs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running beside her allows me to read her 
breathing and movements clearly. Far 
better than watching from a distance, I 
can closely assess her condition—that was 
the reasoning behind it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, puff...
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, did you win the 
capsule toy you wanted?

Come to think of it, did you win the 
capsule toy you wanted?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No... not a single one! I try every time I 
go to the cafeteria, but so far, I have 
zero Rare Q-marus...
choice_data_list:
I'm trying my best too, but I've still got 
a long way to go...

I'm doing my best too, but it's just not 
working at all...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, thank you! But really, in the first 
place... why is there a capsule toy 
machine in the cafeteria? It's a 
mystery..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while making small talk, I'm 
constantly wondering if there's anything 
different about her. My mind is completely 
full of Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~...! My body feels all nice and warm!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good! Alright, let's start 
training—"
choice_data_list:
Ai, right now... your fatigue level is at 
'3', right?

Ai, right now... your fatigue level is at 
"3," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Uh! ...No! 'Two'!
choice_data_list: And the truth?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...... It's a 『3』. I hear you, let's 
keep it moderate today!
choice_data_list:
Let's rest for now and start in the 
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through thorough communication, she 
remains in great condition. Though her 
actual number of training sessions is 
fewer than the others—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By structuring the training menu with 
clear variations, we're achieving the 
results we originally aimed for. This 
turned out to be a pleasant surprise.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad things are going smoothly...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, you're back! Good morning, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Blast! ...And—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Ai-chan! Your eyes are 
sparkling today too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Kiseki. Last year's Kikuka Sho 
winner, a GⅠ Umamusume who, true to her 
name, performed a miracle by tearing 
through an unprecedentedly bad track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't seen a win since then, but 
because she brings all kinds of surprises 
every time she runs, she remains hugely 
popular with racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Man, that's seriously amazing. The way 
these highlights are done is gonna be such 
good reference for character design...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on... Aren't you staring a bit too 
much?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sorry, sorry! You're just so pretty, I 
guess I'll never quite get used to it.
choice_data_list:
By the way, did you need something from 
Ai?

By the way, did you need something from 
Ai?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was hanging out with Blast-chan and came 
up with all sorts of moves! I really want 
Ai-chan to try them out too!
choice_data_list: Technique...?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Are you interested?! Then play with us 
too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
First, a demonstration! Which one do you 
want, the "Giant Blast" or the 
"Kiseki-Style Amazing Sault"!?
choice_data_list: What!? I-I...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure what kind of example to 
follow, but I'll leave it to you.
choice_data_list: "Giant Blast"
'Kiseki-Style Amazing Salto'

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Here goes! "Giant Blast"—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*BOOOOOOOM!!!!!*)
choice_data_list: Oooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—T-that tackle was incredible...! The 
punching bag is completely wrecked...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A dynamic move making full use of 
Blast-chan's build that knocks you out in 
one hit! Augh, I want to see it in a 
full-page spread!
choice_data_list:
By the way, why are you developing special 
moves?

By the way, why are you developing special 
moves?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, mats were laid out 
outside, complete with steel posts and 
ropes. It looked just like a pro wrestling 
ring.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We were thinking up special moves for a 
battle manga, and decided to actually try 
doing them ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And then your face popped into my head, 
Ai-chan! You're so athletic, I just had to 
see what it'd look like if you gave it a 
shot!
choice_data_list: Are you gonna do it, Ai...?
Are you gonna do it, Ai...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's expecting a lot from me, so 
for now—let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Here I go...! "Giant Blast"!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~! That acceleration clicked right 
in... So smart!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, it wouldn't have the same impact as 
yours, would it? If I were to do it... I'd 
want to use the rebound of the ropes too!
choice_data_list: (She's taking this so seriously...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the day will ever come when I 
can reveal my newly developed 
"Three-Through Spear"...?
choice_data_list: My "Trainer Chop" too...
My "Trainer Chop" too...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now is the hour to take flight! Unleash! 
'Kiseki-Style Amazing Salto'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*hup!* *spin, spin, spin, spin—bam!*)
choice_data_list: Oooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Look at all those somersaults...! It's 
just like a circus!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I wanted to surprise everyone, so I 
pulled off a diving attack right off the 
top turnbuckle!
choice_data_list:
By the way, why are you developing special 
moves?

By the way, why are you developing special 
moves?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, mats were laid out 
outside, complete with turnbuckles and 
ropes. It looked just like a pro wrestling 
ring.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We were thinking up special moves for a 
battle manga, and decided to actually try 
doing them ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And then your face popped into my head, 
Ai-chan! You're so athletic, I just had to 
see what it'd look like if you gave it a 
shot!
choice_data_list: Are you gonna do it, Ai...?
Are you gonna do it, Ai...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's expecting a lot from me, so 
for now—let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll decide it with all my might! 
—"Kiseki-style Amazing Salto"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*glide!* *spin, spin, spin—tap!*)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
W-What brilliance...! Truly taking flight! 
And each and every one of those spins is 
gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was one less spin than you. If 
I were to do it, I'd want it to be even 
flashier...!
choice_data_list: (She's taking this so seriously...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the day will ever come when I 
can reveal my newly developed "Thunder Eye 
Shot"...?
choice_data_list: My "Trainer Chop" too...
My "Trainer Chop" too...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Well then... Shall we start training soon?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I fixed up the menu too, so take a 
look.

Yeah, I fixed up the menu too, so take a 
look!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I showed her was the whiteboard. 
Because the regimen changes frequently 
depending on her condition, I've recently 
been writing it on the board to share with 
her.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? You can actually tackle this pretty 
thoroughly, can't you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The workload is higher than the day before 
yesterday... Even though we agreed to take 
it easy this morning.
choice_data_list:
I saw how you were doing earlier and 
thought you could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...You're confident, aren't you?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'll make sure you get thorough care 
too!

Yeah. We'll take care of you perfectly, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right! Well then, I'll give it everything 
I've got, too!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list: Ai?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I have to win the Shuka Sho! —For your 
sake, too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Just now... I..."
choice_data_list:
...Are you saying you're doing this for my 
sake?
...Are you saying it's for my sake?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see. Since when did...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not lying. For now, isn't that 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get down to training! I'm going 
to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...That's all for today. ............"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *brrr*... So cold.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a relief. But you startled 
me, you know? You were staring out at the 
sea so blankly.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was training just a moment ago... My 
face got a little flushed, you see. I was 
just cooling off.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Are you okay? What about Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She's watching over me from over there 
while adjusting my regimen.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This level of fatigue is well within 
expectations. I've adjusted the workload 
so it builds strength without causing heat 
buildup.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Man, they're really going the extra mile, 
huh? ...Well, guess you don't wanna slack 
off."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...If I win the next one too, that'll be 
the Triple Tiara, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Come to think of it, you're 
right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ..."Come to think of it"? Really?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san... really doesn't care about that 
title at all, does she?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right. What I'm aiming for... is to 
win the races I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Titles will follow once you win.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“...I'm sure Ai-san's gonna win the Triple 
Tiara.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd be an honor if I pulled it 
off! But I don't know if that's how it'll 
go.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You never know what will happen in a 
race. ...The next one to win might just be 
you."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
………………— Are you... really serious about 
that?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's true! That's why I train, and why I 
never let my guard down. I make 
adjustments right down to the wire.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Because I definitely want to win! Don't 
you feel the same?
